slug: 2024-09-20 Ghana Digital Economy (US Country Commercial Guide)

facts.fact: The US Country Commercial Guide lists the 2003 ICT for Accelerated Development (ICT4AD) Policy among the key facets of Ghana's communications-sector policy, as of its publication on 2024-09-20.
The guide states the Ministry of Communications and Digitalization directs communications-sector policy in Ghana, as of its publication on 2024-09-20.
